title: REQ · Send shows a loading label while the submission is in flight
summary: Button label switches to 'Sending…' during the request and back to 'Send' afterwards.
description: Context: the button always reads 'Send'. Desired behavior: while submitContribution is pending, the label is 'Sending…'; it reverts to 'Send' on success or failure. Why: visible progress feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending submitContribution, when the sheet renders, then the button name is 'Sending…'.
Given the request resolved or rejected, when the sheet re-renders, then the button name is 'Send' again.
technical_constraints: Reuse the in-flight state introduced for REQ-1 (a single 'submitting' boolean)
